summary: Implemented all 4 plan phases. Phase 1 replaced git-commit-scoped.sh's blind `if ! git add` exit-code guard with post-add index-state verification (V7), tolerating the gitignore-advisory false negative on a tracked, ignore-matched path while still refusing a genuine add failure with exit 2. Phase 2 added 6 regression cases plus a negative control to test-git-commit-scoped.sh (32 passed, 0 failed). Phase 3 recorded the positive-pathspec hazard in git-staging-scope.md. Phase 4 independently re-ran the full gate set in this dispatch: baseline FAIL 2/33, full FAIL 3/34, every failure attributed -- gates 3/5 to this task's own un-redeployed source-store edits, and the one gate-8 run-all.sh suite set to other concurrently-dispatched tasks or pre-existing unrelated suites (test-git-commit-scoped.sh itself stayed green throughout).
